text.text: Cars and trucks keep to the widened ring road. All parking moves to hubs at the edge, within a 200 m walk of any door. Inside, motorbikes, bicycles and scooters slow to 15 km/h and people have priority. Some lanes are for people only.
The road system: cars on the ring road, parking at the edge, and slow streets inside.
